heading: Bureau established
lead: There shall be established in the Department of Labor a bureau to be known as the Women’s Bureau.

notes.heading: Transfer of Functions
notes.text: For transfer of functions of other officers, employees, and agencies of Department of Labor, with certain exceptions, to Secretary of Labor, with power to delegate, see Reorg. Plan No. 6 of 1950, §§ 1, 2, 15 F.R. 3174, 64 Stat. 1263, set out in the Appendix to Title 5, Government Organization and Employees.
